title: 科技拥挤交易松动：资金竟同时转向，医疗与超大规模云厂商
speaker: Sean Cochran

segments.en: Yeah, so I think that you you mentioned a little earlier the strength in healthcare and certainly that's a reflection of investors looking for more opportunity and trying to diversify from that singular trade that is certainly crowded and everyone's in so if we look at that.
segments.zh: 是的，你之前提到医疗板块的强势，这反映出投资者在寻找更多机会，试图从那个拥挤的单一交易中分散出来。

segments.en: Tech it's really as simple as as long as the CapEx continues then you have an environment where you've got strong growth that semi-conductor trade remains alive and so tech has a fundamental underpinning.
segments.zh: 科技其实很简单，只要资本开支持续，就有强劲增长的环境，半导体交易就依然活跃，科技有基本面支撑。

segments.en: But investors understand that there is risk to that CapEx and also they don't want to be on a single trades. They're looking for diversification opportunities in healthcare. They see something it has a little bit of both in that.
segments.zh: 但投资者明白资本开支存在风险，也不想押注单一交易。他们在医疗板块寻找分散机会，那里两者兼有。

segments.en: The healthcare sector is showing evidence that they can benefit from AI deploying your technologies especially around drug development at the same time. It's not entirely driven by this tech story. That's why you're seeing these sorts of rotations.
segments.zh: 医疗板块显示出能受益于AI技术部署的证据，尤其是在药物研发方面，同时又不完全由科技叙事驱动。这就是出现这类轮动的原因。

segments.en: Yeah, there's rotation as we mentioned right it. So the advice is still to diversify away from maybe the memory side of things. There is a rotation back into the hyperscalers. Is that sort of the right direction you think of travel now Sean?
segments.zh: 是的，正如我们提到的，存在轮动。所以建议仍是分散，或许从存储侧分散出来。现在有资金轮动回超大规模云厂商。Sean，你认为这是正确的方向吗？

segments.en: Yeah, so I think that the rotation back towards the hyperscale is there's multiple elements going on. What we know is that Amazon certainly in its last earnings call did a good job of explaining to the investors that.
segments.zh: 是的，我认为资金轮动回超大规模云厂商有多个因素。我们知道亚马逊在最近一次财报电话会上向投资者做了很好的解释。

segments.en: They have a path to monetization the additional trend going on that might return some confidence to the hyperscalers is the idea that cloud is robust in that there one of the big debates is is it frontier models or is it open weight models.
segments.zh: 他们有变现路径。另一个可能让超大规模云厂商恢复信心的趋势是云业务稳健，其中一个重大争论是前沿模型还是开放权重模型。

segments.en: And I know for our own work we like to use all of them. We take a harness and whatever's the right model at the time is the model that we're going to deploy into to get the most cost effective outcome.
segments.zh: 在我们自己的工作中，我们喜欢都用。我们搭建框架，当时哪个模型合适就用哪个，以获得最具成本效益的结果。

segments.en: The big push for the market is how do I lower the cost of deploying AI and get value from AI in that environment. The hyperscalers can do well because in a cloud environment cloud environment doesn't matter frontier model open weight model.
segments.zh: 市场的主要推动力是如何降低AI部署成本并从中获取价值。超大规模云厂商能表现良好，因为在云环境中，前沿模型还是开放权重模型并不重要。

segments.en: You must deploy on the cloud and that's why you can get some rotation back to the hyperscalers of the market regains confidence. It's not just about the semiconductor trade. Semiconductors is robust as long as the capex is there.
segments.zh: 你必须在云上部署，这就是为什么当市场恢复信心时，资金会轮动回超大规模云厂商。这不仅仅是半导体交易。只要资本开支在，半导体就稳健。
